12: /-- Graph of S* S for an antilinear S, given by the adjoint pairing.

14: nor selfadjointness. Those analytic properties are not hidden premises. -/
15: def antilinearSquareGraph (G : Set (H × H)) : Set (H × H) :=
16:   {p | ∃ sx : H, (p.1,sx) ∈ G ∧ ∀ y sy : H, (y,sy) ∈ G →
17:     inner ℂ p.2 y = inner ℂ sy sx}

20:     (G : Set (H × H)) (G' : Set (K × K))
21:     (hg : (U.toHomeomorph.prodCongr U.toHomeomorph) '' G = G')
22:     (x z : H) (hx : (x,z) ∈ antilinearSquareGraph G) :
23:     (U x,U z) ∈ antilinearSquareGraph G' := by
24:   obtain ⟨sx,hsx,hpair⟩ := hx
25:   refine ⟨U sx,?_,?_⟩
26:   · rw [← hg]; exact ⟨(x,sx),hsx,rfl⟩
27:   · intro y' sy' hy
28:     rw [← hg] at hy
29:     obtain ⟨q,hq,he⟩ := hy
30:     have hy' : U q.1 = y' := congrArg Prod.fst he
31:     have hsy' : U q.2 = sy' := congrArg Prod.snd he
32:     rw [← hy',← hsy']
33:     simpa using hpair q.1 q.2 hq

22:   have hb : spectrum ℝ B ⊆ s := Set.subset_union_right

24:     induction g using ContinuousMap.induction_on_of_compact with

27:         U * cfcHomSuperset hB hb (algebraMap ℝ C(s,ℝ) r)

29:       exact Algebra.commutes r U

33:     | add g k hg hk => simp only [map_add,add_mul,mul_add,hg,hk]
